name: gmail_check_unread
description: Check Gmail for new unread messages and return them as structured data. Use this when you need to monitor the inbox for new emails, triage incoming mail, or create tasks from unread messages.

max_results.description: Maximum number of unread messages to retrieve (default: 10)

vault_path.description: Path to AI Employee Vault for action file creation (default: 'AI_Employee_Vault')

credentials_path.description: Path to Gmail OAuth credentials.json (default: looks for 'credentials.json' in project root)

create_action_files.description: Whether to create .md action files in Needs_Action/ folder (default: true)
